instruction: Look at task-003_initial.scad. Make a linear carriage block: bounding size 100 x 46 x 24 mm, two parallel rounded rail clearance slots 72 x 6 mm centered at y=+/-13 mm, four vertical M5 mounting holes at (+/-38,+/-16), a raised central pad spanning at least 80 x 30 mm above z=18, and crisp outside reference corners at x=+/-42, y=+/-21, z=0 and z=24. Fully render and export /home/user/Desktop/task-003_output.stl. Do not create PNG, PDF, CSV, JSON, or any other extra output. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
